heading, Connecting patients with life-changing therapies at home, level 1
link, Learn more about our services
heading, The fastest route to patients, level 2

Sciensus is the UK’s leading provider of complex clinical care at home. For over 30 years, we have partnered with the NHS to deliver specialist medicines, clinical nursing and patient support to people living with cancer, rare diseases and complex long-term conditions – supporting more than 300,000 patients a year across 180+ NHS trusts.

Beyond the UK, Sciensus helps pharmaceutical and biotech companies reach patients across Europe, managing the regulatory, logistics and patient support complexity of launching medicines in multiple markets.

Sciensus stays at the forefront of healthcare innovation and expert patient care with our unique model combining human care with advanced digital solutions. At the core of our services is 30 years of human-led patient care across a variety of complex therapeutic areas, powered by our proprietary integrated intelligence engine.

Our unique digital solutions enhance patient engagement, connect the clinician to the patient journey, optimise operations for health systems and enable collection of more accurate and timely real-world data. AI integration uses this real-world data to fuel predictive analytics and outcome tracking, leading to informed decision-making and proactive treatment modifications that result in better outcomes and maximised value of treatment for all stakeholders.

Unparalleled advantage is created for patients, clinicians, health systems and biopharma companies through the synergies produced when human care is integrated with our innovative digital support platforms.

Leading our partners to connect patients to life-changing therapies faster – with unique integrated solutions, combining human care and advanced digital tools, to drive access, efficiency and better outcomes across Europe.
Safe, compliant, pan-European logistics – from import and title to last-mile delivery and order-to-cash.

heading, Are you a patient?, level 2
Visit our patient hub for support, guidance, resources and more.
We work closely with all business and healthcare stakeholders to unlock European markets faster, improve outcomes for patients and deliver real-world evidence for rapid, smarter decision-making.

Whether you’re launching a new therapy, scaling market access across Europe or supporting real-world evidence generation, Sciensus delivers the infrastructure, expertise and digital capability to help you reach the right patients at the right time with the right support.

Our holistic end-to-end service creates capacity in overburdened systems through reliable and efficient medication dispensing, digitally enabled clinician-led care and engaging patient support programmes that improve adherence and overall health outcomes.

We can partner to expand capabilities, unlock new geographies and provide additional capacity across the drug development lifecycle – from non-interventional trials to launch planning, early access programmes and pan-European distribution.
heading, Expertise that makes the difference, level 2
With our clinical expertise, 30 years’ experience and insights from over 70m interactions, no one knows patients like we do.
worth of drugs distributed each year
Sciensus’ end-to-end capabilities, fuelled by digital innovation, accelerate patients’ access to medicines across Europe
heading, European operations network: the fastest route to patients, level 3
We simplify Europe’s complexity with a single integrated hub for distribution and compliance. That means fewer barriers, less risk and faster time-to-patient across multiple markets.
heading, Patient engagement: care that drives outcomes, level 3

Because we’re closest to patients, we don’t just deliver medicines – we keep people engaged in their treatment. Whether through in-home care or digital support tools, we improve adherence, persistence and quality of life.
heading, Evidence generation: insight grounded in lived experience, level 3

Our unique position at the patient interface means we can capture real-world data that reflects how therapies perform in everyday life. These insights strengthen HTA submissions, accelerate uptake and support long-term product value.
